name: protobuf
description: Protocol Buffers - Google's data interchange format
Forked from microsoft/vcpkg's 3.6.0.1 port, which trinity pins through an override
because the desktop build is on v141. The only change is how protoc is obtained when
host and target triplets differ: upstream keyed that off CMAKE_HOST_WIN32 and a
hardcoded x86-windows path, which cannot work for arm64-android or arm64-ios.
